prompt:
Use the reference cube, opposite-face hints, and labeled image options in the image: an outline-style reference cube, three opposite-face hint pairs, and six labeled option cubes underneath. Use the reference cube and opposite-face hints to identify the correct image option. Select the labeled option that could show the same cube from another viewpoint. Answer with the option letter.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence field: set "evidence" to an array containing exactly one bounding box [x1, y1, x2, y2] for the correct option panel.
Answer field: set "answer" to the exact option letter of the correct image option.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[340,638,484,824]],"answer":"C"}
